Mir Mena C. Bartoro South Oxfod Mass

Copy •

COMHONWEAITE

OF

MASSACHUSETTS.

EXECUTIVE DEPARTMENT.

Boston, March 24th, 1862.

Miss Clara H. Barton North Oxford,

Mass • I beg to assure you, Miss Barton, of my cordial sympathy with your most vorthy santiments and wishes; and that if I have any power to promote your design in aid of our soldiere I will frealy uss it.

Whenever you may be ready to visit Gen'l. Burnsides division I will cheerfully give you a letter of introduction, with my hearty approval of your visit and my testimony to the value of the servics to our sick and wounded, it will be in your power to tander. With high respect I am Your ob. servant

John A. Andrews.
